chapters.title: Plain recursion

frames.caption: Plain recursion — O(3m+n) time, O(m + n) extra space. Input: min_distance(a='ab', b='ba'). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
def f(i, j): (edits to turn a[:i] into b[:j])
return 1 + min(f(i - 1, j - 1), f(i - 1, j), f(i, j - 1)) — calls f(i=1, j=1)
return 1 + min(f(i - 1, j - 1), f(i - 1, j), f(i, j - 1)) — calls f(i=0, j=0)

return 1 + min(f(i - 1, j - 1), f(i - 1, j), f(i, j - 1)) — calls f(i=3, j=0)
